entries.estimatedFrom: ESTIMATED FROM MEDIAN for American Samoa, Guam, the Northern Mariana Islands and the U.S. Virgin Islands: 8.85 vehicle revenue miles per resident a year, the median of the 52 recorded 2024 state, D.C. and Puerto Rico rates. Source: FTA National Transit Database 2024 (https://data.transportation.gov/d/ekg5-frzt); use the recorded rates because matching 2024 population denominators for these four territories are absent from this calibration.

entries.gap: The aggregate firearm-homicide measure records no personal exposure or victimization.
entries.estimate: Route a changed place rate to resident safety-context estimates; preserve the rate's firearm-share and territory proxy limitations. Do not produce injuries or deaths.
entries.estimatedFrom: CDC National Center for Health Statistics 2024 age-adjusted homicide mortality rates and CDC FastStats 2024 national firearm share (15,364 of 20,162 homicides), as calibrated in crime.firearm-homicide. Each place rate is an estimate using that national firearm share; the five territory rates retain the sourced Florida or Hawaii proxies recorded in the place measure. This is an estimate of a resident's safety context. It assigns no individual firearm exposure, injury, homicide, or personal victimization.
